draft.subject: Getting your first project set up in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Glad the notification badge issue got sorted on your ticket last week -- thanks for flagging it so we could fix it. Do shout if anything still looks off there.

While you're getting settled: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything about Granite Ventures' setup.

Best,
Priya
